calibration.model: mean-anomaly shift dM = -(c1*tau + c2*tau^2 + c3*tau^3) arcsec, tau in Julian centuries from the seed epoch
calibration.fitted_on: Hold-out: reduced model seeded from DE441 at 6000 BCE, 6,800 years back to 12,800 BCE, compared with DE441

independent_v3_moon_arcsec.note: v3 started from DE440 at J2000; correction applied with tau from J2000

calibration.limitation: Empirical: reproduces DE441 lunar mean motion over the 6,800-year hold-out. Before 13,200 BCE it assumes DE441-era tidal dissipation persists; real ancient dissipation is uncalibrated.

seed_fit.note: c1 measured forward from the DE441 start (JD -3,100,014.5) against DE441; c2, c3 from the 6000 BCE hold-out
